name: See Invisibility

header.Components: V, S, M (a pinch of talc)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Self sees Invisible creatures/objects normally and Ethereal creatures/objects as ghostly translucent; one-hour source; no general Truesight.

rules.text: For the duration, you see creatures and objects that have the Invisible condition as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane.
Creatures and objects there appear ghostly.
